name: W Bali - Seminyak
positioning: A Seminyak beach hotel in the heart of Bali's fashion and nightlife scene, with a rice field-inspired WET pool, ocean-view rooms and Oasis Villas with private plunge pools
best_for: Couples and friends who want Seminyak nightlife with a villa and private pool to retreat to
Social travelers drawn to a DJ-led pool deck and an oceanfront beach club

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Bali's fashion and nightlife scene in Seminyak.
At WET Deck, resident DJs play while guests lounge poolside with handcrafted cocktails.
Villas range from one to three bedrooms and are inspired by traditional Balinese design and rice paddy landscapes.
Each space features signature W design and curated local art.
AWAY Spa offers midnight massages and sunrise yoga.
Starfish Bloo is a beachfront restaurant serving Mediterranean cuisine with Asian influences, known for its Sunday brunch.
Alunê is an oceanfront beach club with private pool cabanas.
Conde Nast Traveler says the hotel is within walking distance of many restaurants.
The W Insider gives access to Seminyak's hidden gems and the island's fashion, music and nightlife.

highlights.text: The Oasis Villas have private plunge pools, lush gardens and expansive sundecks.
The WET pool is inspired by rice fields.
Villa guests can have a floating breakfast in their private pool.
Rooms and suites look out on gardens or the Indian Ocean.
AWAY Spa combines Balinese healing with W's neon energy.
Conde Nast Traveler describes a five-story hotel built around a lagoon pool on the Seminyak shoreline.

considerations.text: Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
WhataHotel notes the busy Seminyak area can be crowded during peak tourist seasons.

sources.title: W Bali - Seminyak - Condé Nast Traveler review
